answer: Tie each agent identity to its own slowly maturing storage proof: every epoch it must prove it still holds a unique, ever-growing archive of its past work, sealed with its key so no copy can be shared. Like shale built layer on layer, the archive cannot be rushed or forged. One honest agent keeps one archive; a farm of N clones must buy and keep N separate disks forever, real ferrous hardware, and auditors sample them at random. Even a forged sonnet of logs fails the seal check.
